test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

They asked me my name.

options.text: My name is asked by them.
My name was asked from me.
I was asked by them of my name.

solution: The correct answer is **"****I was asked my name."**
